newsitem.title: USA: Midcoast files for 2.1 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Midcoast files for 2.1 mln common shares.

text.p: Midcoast Energy Resources Inc filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to sell up to 2.1 million common shares.

Of the total amount, two million shares will be offered by the company and 100,000 will be sold by a selling stockholder, Midcoast said in the filing. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 4,500,000 common.

The underwriters were granted a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 315,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Oppenheimer & Co Inc, A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc and Coleman and Company Securities Inc.
Net proceeds will be used to repay bank debt incurred in connection with the AlaTenn acquisition.
Midcoast, based in Houston, Texas, is primarily engaged in transportation, gathering, processing and marketing of natural gas and other petroleum products.
